title: Before going outside
topic: It has suddenly started raining. May I borrow this umbrella until I go home?
levelRationale: N5-oriented expression matching, not English-translation recognition. Numbered choices differ in communicative purpose; tips explain less familiar scene vocabulary. Stock voices and exact output still require listening approval.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、返事を一つ選んでください。

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 急に雨が降ってきましたね。この傘、帰るまで借りてもいいですか。
turns.translation: It has suddenly started raining. May I borrow this umbrella until I go home?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 1。ええ、どうぞ使ってください。
turns.spokenText: いち。ええ、どうぞ使ってください。

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 2。いいえ、まだ降っていません。
turns.spokenText: に。いいえ、まだ降っていません。

turns.speaker: a
turns.spokenText: さん。はい、昨日返しました。

options.label: ええ、どうぞ使ってください。
options.rationale: This grants the requested permission to borrow.

options.label: いいえ、まだ降っていません。
options.rationale: This denies the explicitly observed rain instead of responding to the borrowing request.

options.label: はい、昨日返しました。
options.rationale: This reports a past return by the respondent rather than granting or refusing the present request.

explanation: 借りてもいいですか asks permission. An appropriate refusal would also be possible, but none is offered among these distractors.
